{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
data_clean = data.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = data_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean values to capture exact numbers
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
print(highest_mean_species)"}
